component.name: Name Shift
component.summary: Bulk-rename files and folders with a live preview

description.p: Name Shift renames many files (and folders) at once. Stack up rename rules, watch a live before → after preview of every name, and press Rename. Every batch is saved as a version you can preview and revert.

Safety is the brand: renames run in two phases so name swaps and case-only renames can never collide, naming conflicts are detected and block renaming until fixed, and the full history can be rolled back.
